# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplemental assessment documents generated for the `microservices-demo` application. Use the links below as the entry point to the detailed architecture, dependency, API, data, configuration, and workflow findings that accompany the main assessment report.

- [Architecture Diagram](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level application architecture and key component relationships.
- [Dependency Map](./dependency-map.md) - Declared build dependencies grouped by functional category and test support.
- [API & Service Communication Contracts](./api-service-contracts.md) - Service catalog, endpoint inventory, and inter-service call patterns.
- [Data Architecture & Persistence Layer](./data-architecture.md) - Database configuration, entity model, repository methods, and data boundaries.
- [Configuration & Externalized Settings Inventory](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, properties, startup inputs, and framework versions.
- [Core Business Workflows](./business-workflows.md) - Domain mapping, key workflows, and business-rule sequencing.
